def get_elevation_extremes(self) -> MinimumMaximum:
    """
    Calculate elevation extremes of track segment

    Returns
    -------
    min_max_elevation: MinimumMaximum named tuple
        minimum: float
            Minimum elevation in meters
        maximum: float
            Maximum elevation in meters
    """
